result: REJECTED: raised coarse alignment did not transfer through either tested descent
finding: A raised wrist-image correction cannot be transferred with an assumed descent transform. The wrist camera scale and fruit-to-fingertip relation change strongly with the descent posture.
required_design_change: Calibrate a raised-to-final image transfer for a fixed Cartesian descent and preserve wrist pitch, or use overhead Cartesian localization plus a final bounded wrist refinement. Do not close from raised alignment alone.
